purpose: Paper-derived experimental benchmark records; these records are not solver validation results.

source.title: Theoretical and Experimental Studies of the Oil Film in Lubricated Point Contact
source.publication: Proceedings of the Royal Society of London A, 291(1427), 520-536 (1966)

conditions.contact: 1-inch-diameter steel ball on a glass plate
conditions.lubricant: Mineral oil No. 3; 9% paraffinic distillate and 91% bright stock

experimental_observation.quantity: central film thickness divided by ball radius
experimental_observation.presentation: Experimental curves against theoretical film thickness and dimensionless load

blocking_gaps: The paper does not provide a machine-readable point table for the plotted film data.
The exact inlet temperature and oil-specific pressure-viscosity law for the plotted oil-3 points are not recovered.
The figure-based values must be digitized and assigned uncertainty before a quantitative solver comparison.

source.title: Oil Film Thickness and Rolling Friction in Elastohydrodynamic Point Contact

blocking_gaps: The reported fringe order cannot be converted to film thickness without the pressure-dependent optical index and the exact fringe calibration.
Poisson ratios and the lubricant pressure-density relation are not specified for this plotted operating point.
The source presents dimensional film trends in figures rather than a numerical experimental point table.

source.authors: E. Ciulli, T. Draexl, and K. Stadler
source.title: Film Thickness Analysis for EHL Contacts under Steady-State and Transient Conditions by Automatic Digital Image Processing

solver_input_assumptions: The contact modulus is inferred from the rounded Hertz radius, load, and ball radius reported in the paper.

Current Roelands implementation uses z=0.6269990432, converted from alpha_p by matching d(log eta)/dp at zero gauge pressure; this matches only the ambient slope and does not validate the SN500 curve at EHL pressures.
The current Dowson-Higginson density coefficients (a=0.6e-9/Pa, b=1.7e-9/Pa) are assumptions, not Ciulli measurements; rho_0 alone does not determine pressure-dependent density.

experimental_observation.quantity: mid-plane film-thickness profile and central/minimum film thickness
experimental_observation.digitization_method: 400 dpi local PDF render; coordinates calibrated from labeled plot ticks; values sampled every 10 micrometers and rounded to 0.01 micrometer

optional_reference_improvements: Original interferograms and the authors' calibration files.
Pressure-dependent refractive-index data and a reprocessing correction for the measured film reference.
Oil-specific pressure-density measurements and elastic constants to replace the reported-Hertz-geometry modulus inference.
